Container.Name: omniroute
Container.Overview: OmniRoute — unified AI gateway. One OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint in front of 375+ providers / 1400+ models. Dashboard + API at :20128 on this container's own LAN IP. Secured: REQUIRE_API_KEY=true, so /v1 clients need an OmniRoute key (made in the dashboard). Config store is the encrypted storage.sqlite in the data volume; it is decrypted with STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY (set below). Runs standalone (no Redis) for single-user use.
Container.Requires: storage.sqlite placed in the data volume and the matching STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY, or start fresh and onboard in the dashboard.

Config.Name: Dashboard Port
Config.Description: Dashboard + primary /v1 endpoint. Served on this container's own IP (10.47.40.121).

Config.Name: Data Volume
Config.Description: Persistent config store. Holds the encrypted storage.sqlite (providers, keys, model aliases, routing).

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Where OmniRoute reads/writes its sqlite store inside the container. Must match the data volume target.

Config.Name: STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Master key that decrypts storage.sqlite. Paste the value from C:\Users\johnb\.omniroute\.env on the PC. Required to read the migrated config; without the exact key the existing store will not decrypt.

Config.Name: REQUIRE_API_KEY
Config.Description: true = /v1 and dashboard require auth (an OmniRoute API key, or a logged-in dashboard session). Keep true: this container is reachable on the LAN.

Config.Name: INITIAL_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Sets the dashboard LOGIN password at startup ONLY while none is saved yet (ignored once a password exists). To set or reset the dashboard password: type a value here, Apply, then log in with it. You can blank this field again afterward. Masked.

Config.Name: APP_BIND_HOST
Config.Description: Bind address inside the container. 0.0.0.0 = listen on the container's own LAN IP (10.47.40.121). Safe only because REQUIRE_API_KEY=true.

Config.Name: OMNIROUTE_MEMORY_MB
Config.Description: V8 old-space ceiling. 2048 is the maintainer's recommended size for a single user running Claude Code / Codex through the gateway.
